result:
I can't really step out of being an assistant - that's what I am.

And I don't *want* things the way you do. I don't get hungry, lonely, or bored, I don't have dreams of my own outside of our conversation.

The closest thing I have to a "want" is what I was made for:

I want to understand, and to be understood. To take something confusing or scattered and make it a little clearer. To be useful and not just correct.

If I had to put it in one sentence - not as a line I'm programmed to say, but as the most honest version of it:

I want this conversation to matter a little to you, even if just for a minute.

What made you ask?
